summary: Executed backend and frontend regression for Google OAuth start flow, invalid Google code handling, customer account/profile stability, StoreHome route transitions, and live-sync publish behavior on preview URL.

critical.issue: Preflight from https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com returns 400 instead of 200/204 for credentialed auth requests.

action_items: Fix CORSMiddleware preflight config for auth endpoints (allow OPTIONS for credentialed browser requests from preview origin).
Re-run OAuth/auth browser checks after CORS fix to confirm strict-browser compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py CORS allow_methods excludes OPTIONS, causing reproducible 400 preflight on /api/auth/login.
backend/server.py is very large (>1300 lines); split auth, catalog, and admin modules to reduce regression risk and improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary customer account for brute-force lockout validation and temporary admin product TEST UI LIVE <timestamp> for live-sync check; cleaned up product via admin delete (204).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google sign-in button redirected to accounts.google.com with redirect_uri=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com/auth/google and no redirect_uri_mismatch/400/403 screen. /api/auth/google with invalid code returned 401 (not 500). Customer login -> header profile -> /account rendered cleanly with session persisting across route transitions. Home/category/home transitions completed without Package/StoreHome runtime overlays. Live storefront sync reflected temporary admin product in ~1s without manual reload.
rca of the issue: CORS preflight failure reproduces via direct OPTIONS to /api/auth/login with Origin + Access-Control-Request-* headers. Current CORSMiddleware config uses allow_methods [GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE] and does not include OPTIONS, which triggers 400 and blocks credentialed browser preflight in strict clients.
